message: VEXORA v2.2.1 is here with Watch Party!
changelog: Introducing Watch Party: Stream perfectly synced movies with friends.
Shared video controls: pause, play and everyone stays in sync.
Live notifications: easily see who paused or played the video.

features.title: What's New
items: Watch Party: Enjoy synced watching with your friends in real time.
New Servers: Added Vex and Syndra servers for more content sources.
Synced Controls: Play, pause, or skip forward together automatically.
Live Alerts: See who paused or played the stream directly on screen.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Smoother navigation and better stability in Spaces.
